name: FinOps Toolkit CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint PowerShell scripts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install PowerShell
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y powershell

      - name: Install PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: pwsh -Command "Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Force -Scope CurrentUser"

      - name: Run PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: pwsh -Command "Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Severity Warning,Error | Format-Table -AutoSize"

  unit-tests:
    name: Run Pester unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install PowerShell
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y powershell

      - name: Install Pester
        run: pwsh -Command "Install-Module -Name Pester -Force -Scope CurrentUser"

      - name: Execute Pester tests
        run: pwsh -Command "Invoke-Pester -Path .\tests -Output Detailed"

  deploy:
    name: Manual deployment to production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: unit-tests
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
